neet_che_u08_t07_1.working: Taking logs of k = A e^(-Ea/RT) gives ln k = ln A - (Ea/R)(1/T), so the slope is -Ea/R.

neet_che_u08_t07_4.working: A is related to collision frequency (I). e^(-Ea/RT) is the fraction of molecules with energy ≥ Ea (II). The intercept of ln k vs 1/T is ln A (III). The activated complex is the unstable, short-lived species at the energy maximum (IV).

neet_che_u08_t07_5.working: A is true. B is false because the total area under the curve stays constant. C is true since k → A as Ea → 0. D is true per the standard textbook statement. E is false because the log k slope is -Ea/(2.303R). So A, C and D.
